title: Mars, Badly
author: Hallam Knight
tagline: A planet of opportunity. A cargo of problems.
blurb:
Mars was always going to be harder. The water is there, the resources are real, and the rewards are enormous, but so are the risks.

When a vital operation at the Valles Relicta complex goes wrong, the TSV Meridian is pulled into a crisis that runs deeper than equipment failure or corporate rivalry.

As the crew and a joint team on the ground dig for answers, they uncover a series of anomalies beneath the Martian surface that don't fit the data, and a growing realisation that someone wanted them to stay buried.

On a planet built on second chances, Mars might still have a few surprises of its own.

Some discoveries change a planet. Others change everything.
